title: Achieved strength-plastic trade-off in HfMoNbTaTi refractory high-entropy alloy via powder metallurgy process
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying (MA) of Hf, Mo, Nb, Ta, Ti elemental powders at 400 rpm for 50 h, followed by spark plasma sintering (SPS) at 1400-1700°C under 50 MPa pressure for 15 min with furnace cooling
